why: Stage 9b rewrote notes for plain words. A rewrite is a new note and carries the same risk as the one it replaced, so every one is read blind, as repairs are.

instruments.author: .claude/agents/simplifier.md
instruments.rule: census-reader.md unchanged from censuses 007-012: the reader measures truth, not ease, so this rate compares with theirs; the instrument gate must pass before grading

stop_condition: over 5% stops the pass: it means simplifying is changing meaning, a method problem before a batch one
read_design: complete read of every rewrite; census_packets.py slices contiguously; reader sees gloss, charge label and note, never the old note or that it was rewritten
scope: blind re-read of the 8 census-013 repairs by a reader that read none of census 013

entries.definition: to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Builds a thing up past its limits or past the truth, the same overreach as *exaggerate* but named with less open blame.

entries.definition: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Deeply thankful - something so lucky or so fitting is pictured as a gift from above, warmer than *providential*'s sense of a plan.
examples: a heaven-sent rain saved the crops

entries.definition: covered with or smelling of mold
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Mold on a thing or in its smell, taken as stale and damp, where *moldy* makes it disgusting.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names correction or punishment in neutral, official language.
examples: the mother was stern and disciplinary

entries.definition: showing patient and unruffled self-control and restraint under adversity; slow to retaliate or express resentment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Calm, patient restraint under hardship or insult alike, in a stiff, bookish word beside the plainer *forbearing*.
examples: was longanimous in the face of suffering

entries.definition: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainer word for what stirs up anger or resentment, or tends to, keeping the shaken-up feel that clinical *agitative* flattens out.

entries.definition: endowed with the capacity to reason
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Marks a being as able to reason at all - a kind of mind, not a clever one, as in *intelligent life*.

entries.definition: made of inferior workmanship and materials
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Cheap stuff cheaply made, and written off whole as trash, where *shoddy* fixes on poor work passed off as sound.

read_order: sorted by family so a packet carries a family's rewrites together
